autoLayout.notes: css/style/layoutToCSS.ts:39-96; css/sheet/elementRules.ts:254-268. `cases` decides display and direction; `memberCases` apply only when a case above emitted a display.

cases.why: without a layout mode the whole cluster is inert; the element stays in flow

emit: NOT on this element — a negative margin on `<selector> > * + *`, emitted by elementRules
memberCases.why: gap does not accept negative values; overlap is a sibling margin

autoLayoutSizing.notes: css/style/layoutToCSS.ts:130-179. Cases are ordered and the first match wins. `self.layoutSizingOnParentAxis` is the axis-selected key the source computes from parentLayoutMode.

cases.why: the parent main axis already hugs
the parent stretches it across the cross axis already
stated sizing on a flex child that is not FILL must not shrink

otherwise.why: FIXED or absent contributes nothing from this cluster

absolutePositioning.notes: css/style/position.ts:4-27 (hasInsets, impliesAbsolute), 42-59, 84-107 (centerDecls). `cases` decides the position property; `insetCases` decides the offsets. verticalAnchored/horizontalAnchored are presence of top|bottom and start|end respectively.

cases.why: no coordinates, nothing to infer from
outside auto-layout, any coordinate is meaningful
inside auto-layout only a meaningful coordinate implies absolute
a zero-only single anchor inside auto-layout is canvas noise

insetCases.why: an edge anchor on the same axis wins; both would put two values on one property

emit: translate: <-50% on each centred axis, 0 on the other>

strokeRendering.notes: css/style/border.ts:51-53, 73-167. strokeAlign contributes no declaration of its own — it only flips the outline-offset sign. `strokeDashPattern` is NOT consulted: see its own row.

asOutline.source: border.ts:51-53 — a per-side object becomes border-*, a scalar or token becomes outline-*

cases.why: a gradient stroke is painted by a separate pseudo-element rule, not a border or outline

emit: border-width: 0 or outline-width: 0, matching whichever style was emitted
cases.why: a default block must reset a width it did not state

intrinsicSize.notes: css/style/size.ts:22-34. minWidth, minHeight, maxWidth and maxHeight are independent and map one-to-one.

cases.why: a stated ratio derives the height

textTruncation.notes: css/style/truncation.ts:12-37. The multi-line case sets display, so it interacts with the autoLayout cluster on the same element.

cases.why: multi-line clamp changes the display type
